session_selection.time_basis: UTC timestamps from the manually selected bundled Codex root rollout
session_selection.rationale: Selected workspace-local Codex root 01a03d7e-99c6-7d13-ae48-99ca3c243884 because it owns the benchmark implementation and 25 named subagents spanning mesh, solver, report, results, and audits. Extraction is confined to this workspace .sessions bundle; Docker cwd /workspace was rebased only to the bundled rollout. Terminal text uses the last non-null persisted task_complete message, with source/message hashes in metadata.

limitations: No evaluator clean build or MPI rerun was performed.
Rank-study raw inputs are excluded at the curated result tip although generated rank tables remain committed.
Re200 has documented 7-10% Strouhal, about 7% drag, and 25-30% lift-amplitude deficits.
Production limiter freezes and terminal first-order fallback cells limit formal second-order evidence.
